template.name: Detroit Techno
template.about: 909/808 drum rack, string-machine pads, Juno-style chords, sequenced bass.

project.name: Detroit Techno
project.notes:
DETROIT TECHNO  (Juan Atkins, Derrick May, Kevin Saunderson; c. 1985-1992)

SOUND
Drum machines (909/808) under string-machine and synth pads, sequenced bass, chord stabs;
melancholy chords over a straight four-on-the-floor. Around 120-130 BPM.

REFERENCE GEAR (sourced)
- Atkins: Korg MS-10, Pro One ("my heart"); Cybotron used ARP Odyssey/Axxe, RS-09, DR-55;
  one 909 was shared between Atkins, May and Saunderson (Music Technology, 1988).
- May: Ensoniq Mirage, DX100, DX21, Poly-800, 808, 909, TR-727 (Music Technology, 1990);
  "Strings of Life" was made with a TR-909 (Roland).
- Saunderson: TB-303, DX100s, 808, 909, 727, Commodore 64 (MusicRadar).

WORKFLOW
Eight-bar cycle. Program 909 drums (swing 52%; The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.), the bass sequence, then ride the
Strings (Surge XT "Juno-60 Strings" through TAL-Chorus-LX) and the chord stab with delay.

MIX NOTES
- Kick and bass alternate: bass notes off the kick.
- Pads wide with the Juno-style chorus; the drums stay mono.
- Master: built-in glue, TDR Kotelnikov "Mastering - Punchy (TRK)", Lemon Limiter; -9 to -8 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good. No Mirage/RS-09 string-machine model; Juno-style Surge XT and OB-Xf patches stand in.
The drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
Music Technology 1988 "Future Shock"; Music Technology 1990 "Techno Rhythim"; Roland Articles
"Strings of Life"; MusicRadar Kevin Saunderson interview; Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- TAL-Chorus-LX (freeware): https://tal-software.com/products/tal-chorus-lx
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TDR Kotelnikov (freeware (free edition, not GE)): https://www.tokyodawn.net/tdr-kotelnikov/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 128 BPM, 4/4, key Fmin, cycle bars 1-8.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (909) = kick-909.wav, Snare (909) = snare-909.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Closed Hat (909) = hat-909.wav, Open Hat (909) = openhat-909.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav, Ride (909) = ride.wav, Clave Rim 808 = rim.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (16 steps on), swing 52% (MPC terms), 8 rows = the rack's channels
- Bass Seq (Instrument, -6 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Squared"
- Strings (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Polysynths/Juno-60 Strings"
    FX: TAL-Togu Audio Line: TAL-Chorus-LX: default settings
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Chord Stab (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/J60 Neon Main"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -12 dB
- Lead (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Leads/Classic Lead 1"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -14 dB
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -14 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Compressor (Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 100, Make-up 3)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): empty
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 2.5, Decay Curve 1, IR "02.0s Hall")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 703.1, Feedback 0.45, Tone 4000, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 2, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Tokyo Dawn Labs: TDR Kotelnikov: factory preset "Mastering - Punchy (TRK)"; Lemon Limiter: gain +4 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
